title: MyCoffeeShop
shortDescription: A SwiftUI iOS app for browsing, ordering, and managing coffee shop orders.
tagline: A seamless coffee ordering experience — from menu browsing to order confirmation, built natively for iOS.
challenge: Coffee shop customers needed a smooth digital ordering experience that matched the premium feel of the brand, with real-time order tracking and a clean, intuitive UI that works for all age groups.
solution: We built a fully native SwiftUI app following MVVM architecture, integrating Supabase for authentication and backend. The app features cart management, favorites, promo codes, location selection, and push notifications for order updates — all wrapped in smooth animations.

title: Weather App
shortDescription: A beautiful iOS weather app with real-time forecasts and smooth animations.
tagline: Real-time weather data and 5-day forecasts delivered through a sleek SwiftUI interface with interactive bottom sheets.
challenge: Most weather apps either look outdated or sacrifice usability for aesthetics. The goal was to build an app that feels premium, loads fast, and handles poor network conditions gracefully — all optimized for every iPhone screen size.
solution: Built with SwiftUI following strict MVVM and SOLID principles, integrating OpenWeatherMap's API for live data. Features a custom interactive bottom sheet for forecasts, debounced city search, progressive data loading, and centralized error handling for all network edge cases.

title: MoneyTracker
shortDescription: A personal finance iOS app for tracking budgets, goals, and donations.
tagline: A complete personal finance companion — track spending, set savings goals, manage wishlists, and record donations in one clean iOS app.
challenge: Personal finance apps are often either too complex or too shallow — users needed a single app that covers transactions, budgets, savings goals, shopping lists, and charitable giving without feeling overwhelming.
solution: Built with Swift 6 and SwiftUI using a feature-based MVVM architecture. Supabase handles authentication and data persistence. The app includes a budget dashboard, transaction history with categories, goal progress cards, wishlist management, donation tracking with impact summaries, and a profile overview — all with smooth animations and an onboarding flow.

title: News Cloud App
shortDescription: A cross-platform Flutter news app with real-time headlines across 7 categories.
tagline: Real-time top headlines across Business, Health, Science, Sports, and more — delivered through a clean category-driven Flutter experience.
challenge: News consumption is fragmented across too many sources. Users needed a single clean interface to browse headlines by category, with fast loading, rich article cards, and reliable error handling when the network fails.
solution: Built with Flutter and Dart, using Dio for HTTP requests against the NewsAPI. Features a horizontal category carousel with cover images, async data fetching with FutureBuilder, loading indicators, and a detail view per article. Runs on Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Linux, and Windows from a single codebase.
